ios.desc:
Group trips die in chat threads. TripTable gives them an HQ.

DECIDE
Stop arguing in the group chat. Create a vote with real options and a deadline, everyone ranks what they actually want, and instant-runoff tallying picks a winner the group can live with. Ties break deterministically; expired votes close themselves.

PLAN
A shared itinerary with per-item estimated costs and a running budget meter, so everyone sees what the trip costs before anyone books anything.

SPLIT
Log expenses once. Split evenly, by shares, by exact percentages, or hand-entered amounts — cents always add up. At trip end, minimal-transfer settlement shows exactly who pays whom and how much.

NO SIGN-UP FRICTION
No accounts. Open the app, create or join with a 6-character code, done.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your trips sync through your own database, scoped so only invited members see them. No ads, no analytics, no tracking. TripTable never moves money — it tells you who owes whom and hands off to your payment app.

TRIPTABLE PRO — OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION
Free trips hold up to 6 members, with unlimited expense logging, settlement, votes and planning. TripTable Pro removes the member cap across all of your trips and unlocks the organizer closeout pack: bulk payment reminders to all debtors at once, plus CSV export of the expense log for Excel double-checks.

TripTable Pro is an auto-renewing yearly subscription: $29.99/year. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically each year unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your device Settings under Apple Account › Subscriptions.
